casual2.outfit: A charcoal strapless cropped sweater with a ribbed hem and loose sand-coloured skater shorts; the cropped hem exposes her midriff.

why.scene: 첫 등장 무렵 체육관에 시간대와 창·코트의 빛을 보충.

casual3.scene: A ceramic mixing bowl contains crushed Oran berries; a copper saucepan and a jar of honey sit on the tiled counter.
casual3.outfit: A coral peshtemal wrap fashioned as an off-shoulder towel dress, secured at the bust, with a high thigh slit.

why.scene: 나무열매 주방의 혼합 재료와 주변 도구가 없어 구체화.
